title: Analytic thin disks and rings in a class of nonasymptotically flat static spacetimes
summary: External matter distributions can substantially reshape the strong field environment of compact objects, yet this effect is usually neglected in idealized isolated models. In this work, we investigate geometrically thin, optically thick relativistic accretion onto a static axisymmetric space-time that describes a slightly deformed compact object immersed in an external quadrupolar field as an exact solution of vacuum Einstein field equations.
